messages:
Joan C: Observed duplicate usage rows in staging for partnerZ. same tenant+entitlement within same minute.
Alex W: example payload?
Joan C: {tenant_id: 'acme-123', entitlement_id: 'ent-aaa', timestamp: '2026-03-23T16:10:12Z', seq: 42, usage_units: 60, signature: 'sha1=abcd'}
Priya R: Their client retries on 5xx and increments seq. Our idempotency currently uses tenant+entitlement+minute, but partner increments seq so we see multiple events.
Samir D: Short term: collapse duplicates in ingest pipeline within a 2-minute slack window. Keep one event per (tenant, entitlement, minute) unless partner provides usage_breakdown.
Alex W: Pseudocode collapse will take max usage_units per key. We should tag collapsed events so recon can audit.
Joan C: Partner cannot ship client change quickly. They'll accept server-side collapse if we provide daily report and credits.
Priya R: Also signature issue: partner uses HMAC-SHA1; docs require SHA256. We should return 403 with expected algo in body to reduce confusion.
BillingBot: [ALERT] webhook-signature-failures partnerZ 16:12Z - 87 failures in last 5m
Alex W: Plan: (1) deploy ingest de-dupe behind feature flag (Samir) (2) run nightly recon and credit duplicates (Ops/Finance) (3) partner to add dedupe_id + switch to sha256 by next Wed (Joan/Priya).
Samir D: I'll add metrics ingest.duplicates.collapsed and ingest.signature_failures and a feature flag. PR coming.
Priya R: I'll add a small curl snippet to docs for SHA256 header generation and an integration test vector.
Joan C: I'll confirm timeline with partner PM and schedule recon CSV delivery.
Alex W: Thanks — keep thread updated with PR and deploy link.
